messages:
jesse: Heads up — Cascade Health (CAS-442). Renewal ~2026-05-15 (~55 days). Big usage drop: tokens -68% Feb vs Jan. Procurement contact changed to Marta Lopez. Raising renewal-risk triage.
maya: Pulled dashboard — active seats -40%, API calls -67%. Patient-portal integration traffic tanked mid-Feb. Dash: https://redwood.internal/dash/cas-442
devon: Any logs/latency spikes? If integration broke, might be fixable quickly.
jesse: Paste from support log:
```ERROR 503 POST /v1/generate 2026-02-14 03:21:09 upstream timeout model:redwood/small-serve```
usage-alert-bot: Automated alert: Regression detected for CAS-442. 95th percentile latency increased 3x between 2026-02-10 and 2026-02-16. Suggested: canary rollback.
ravi: Sales update — customer running a NimbusAI pilot since 2026-02-20 focused on cheaper embeddings. Marta asked for unit-pricing guarantee + SSO audit. We missed a follow-up while their infra changed.
elaine: Proposed playbook:
1) 30-min troubleshooting session w/ eng + dev
2) Offer 1-week cost credit + quantized inference profile to match pilot
3) Map stakeholders (Marta + CTO Priya) — assign owner
I can own the workshop if maya + dev join.
maya: :thumbsup: I'll join and pull failing-request list + quick prompt set for quality checks.
devon: Need a trace id for a failing request to prepare rollback steps — jesse, can you share one?
jesse: Trace id 2b7f9c8a (payload masked). Support thread noted "10–15% latency spikes during peak hours after infra change".
ravi: I'll ping Marta and loop Priya; recommend we propose a short A/B: quantized config vs current stack.
elaine: Action items: jesse -> schedule session by EOD; maya -> share failing set; devon -> prepare rollback+quantized plan; ravi -> confirm stakeholder times. I'll draft the customer email.
jesse: Session scheduled 2026-03-22 14:00 PT. Invite sent to Marta Lopez (m.lopez@cascadehealth.com) and Priya Shah (CTO). Added 'bring logs & example requests'.
maya: Shared gist with 12 failing requests and snapshot showing model-fallback events: https://gist.github.com/xxxxx
devon: I'll prep rollback doc and a quantized profile. If rollback reduces 95th latency, we offer pilot config + 2-week credit.
ravi: Noted. Marking in renewal tracker as "high risk — triage in progress". Thanks team.
